heldOutSessions.reason: Field rotation over the 250 subs leaves the stacked canvas mostly partial coverage: the pale wedges are where only a handful of frames reached, so the coverage normalisation amplifies them. Useless as a training example, because those wedges are a canvas artefact and not sky. Kept deliberately as a TEST fixture, being exactly the input auto-cropping (LargestCoveredRectangle, the coverage edge walk) and gradient removal have to survive. Decided 2026-09-17.

No calibration exists for this night: no flat was ever shot through this train (FMA180), and no dark for this body at its gain and exposure (it is on darks-to-shoot.csv). The master is the only one in the store with neither, and it shows: the one card of the 2026-10-12 gallery whose sky reads off-neutral after the enhance (sky chroma 0.81, red 0.52 under green), and dust left in the field. A training target must be calibrated, so it is held out of training. The owner's call, 2026-10-12.
